## Contribution

What question does this address? Link the related issue, if there is one.

## Precise statement and scope

State assumptions on the field, group, residue characteristic, and coefficients. Identify which assertions are proved, conditional, or conjectural. Distinguish construction from exhaustion.

## Evidence and verification

Give the key steps and exact references, including their hypotheses. Explain how calculations can be reproduced and note any unresolved steps.

## Review notes

List relevant prior work, limitations, and AI assistance. Automated or AI review does not establish correctness; a maintainer decides whether the evidence supports merging.
